description: Deep automated risk check for one token. Solana: Jupiter audit (mint/freeze authority, top-holder concentration, organic score, verified) + RugCheck report (LP locked, risks). EVM: GoPlus (honeypot, buy/sell tax, mintable, proxy, owner powers, verified source). Plus liquidity/age/FDV heuristics from DexScreener. Returns level low/medium/high/unknown, flags, raw checks, market data and a swapUrl. Heuristics can miss scams: always pass on the disclaimer. Result includes `display` markdown with chan images: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
name: token_risk
title: Token risk check
